BURSEVI:v6p216#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p216#2/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p216#2/r2.claim: He asks no wage for counsel and invitation because payment would cast suspicion on people of integrity.
BURSEVI:v6p216#2/r2.anchor: أي : على النصح والدعاء. {من أجر} فإن ذلك تهمة لأهل العفة.

STUDYQURAN:26:141/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:141/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:26:141/r1.claim: The opening of Ṣāliḥ's story repeats the pattern used for other prophets, as discussed for Noah.
STUDYQURAN:26:141/r1.anchor: For a similar opening to other prophets’ stories, cf. vv. 105–9, 123–27, 160–64, 176–80.

TAB-FULL:v17p618/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v17p618/r3.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v17p618/r3.claim: Ṣāliḥ urges them to fear punishment and obey his warning and his command to follow God’s obedience.
TAB-FULL:v17p618/r3.anchor: {فاتقوا الله} [آل عمران: 50] أيها القوم، واحذروا عقابه {وأطيعون} [آل عمران: 50] في تحذيري إياكم، وأمر ربكم باتباع طاعته.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p516/r7.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p516/r7.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p516/r7.claim: Ṣāliḥ asks for no payment; his reward is recompense from the Lord of the worlds.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p516/r7.anchor: إن ثوابي. {إلا على رب العالمين {145} أتتركون في ما ههنا آمنين {146}

ELMALILI:26:141-159/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:26:141-159/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:26:141-159/r2.claim: He urges them to fear God and obey him.
ELMALILI:26:141-159/r2.anchor: Gelin Allah’tan korkun ve bana itaat edin (144).

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:144/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:144/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:144/r1.claim: The command is rendered as avoiding disobedience to God and obeying Salih.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:144/r1.anchor: Artık Allah’a karşı gelmekten sakının ve bana itaat edin

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r1.claim: Ṣāliḥ’s opening appeal repeats the formulation used at the end of the preceding prophetic account, where it was already explained.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r1.anchor: Precisely these verses have been mentioned at end of the last anecdote and they have been explained there.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r3.claim: The command to fear God and obey Ṣāliḥ warns against following deviant leaders and reminds the people that the horrific day is near.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p436/r3.anchor: The words “so, fear God and obey me” sound a warning to these people.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p438/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p438/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p438/r1.claim: Ṣāliḥ repeats the warning from verse 144, reminding his people that they still have time to fear God and obey him.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p438/r1.anchor: This is the same warning that was sounded in verse 144 earlier. Ṣāliḥ (sws) once again told them that they still have time.

NASHR:v2p336/r10.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p336/r10.speaker: يعقوب
NASHR:v2p336/r10.claim: Yaqub affirms the sixteen listed extra yāʾs in both connected and pause forms: the eight quoted forms plus أطيعون in eight places.
NASHR:v2p336/r10.anchor: أثبت الياء في جميعها يعقوب في الحالين

QIRAAT-ER:26:144:5#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:26:144:5#1/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:26:144:5#1/r1.claim: Adding the final yāʾ gives a fuller first-person pronoun form and lengthens the ending.
QIRAAT-ER:26:144:5#1/r1.anchor: Addition of final yāʾ to the first-person pronoun — wa-aṭīʿūnī with long ī

ALUSI-FULL:v19p112#4/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p112#4/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p112#4/r1.claim: The discussion of Salih's call to fear God and obey him is the same as the preceding explanation of this recurring prophetic formula.

BAYDAWI-FULL:26:138-144/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:138-144/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:138-144/r5.claim: The gardens and springs specify the comforts just mentioned.
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:138-144/r5.anchor:
ثم فسره بقوله:
{ في جنت وعيون }

BIQAI-FULL:v5p380/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p380/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p380/r1.claim: Because Salih has established his commission, he calls them to fear God; because he is trustworthy, he calls them to obey him.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p176/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p176/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p176/r4.claim: The command to fear God and obey the messenger follows from the preceding rebuke as in the story of Hud.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p176/r4.anchor: مفرع مثل نظيره في قصة عاد

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r4.claim: Ṣāliḥ sought no wage from them for his call; he sought its reward only from God and then reminded them of God's favors.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p155/r4.anchor: أنه لا يبتغي بدعوتهم أجرا منهم، وإنما يطلب ثواب ذلك من الله، عز وجل

JISHUMI:v7p5377/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5377/r11.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5377/r11.claim: Ṣāliḥ is trustworthy in conveying the message and calls them to fear God, avoid disobedience, and obey what was delivered.
JISHUMI:v7p5377/r11.anchor: فاتقوا الله ولا تعصوه وأطيعون فيما أودي إليكم

MUQATIL:26:141-153/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:141-153/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:141-153/r5.claim: Ṣalih urges them to worship God and obey his instructions.
